title: Long Hinglish call with false urgency near the end

lines.t: Namaste, main Ravi bol raha hoon Suraksha Life Insurance se. Kya meri baat Patil ji se ho rahi hai?
Haan ji, boliye.
Aapne website pe call back request kiya tha, usi ke baare mein call kiya hai.
Haan haan, bataiye.
Aage badhne se pehle, verification ke liye apni date of birth confirm kar dijiye.
Chaudah August, unnees sau chhiyaasi.
Dhanyavaad, record se match ho gaya.
Aap kis cheez ke liye save karna chahte hain, aur ghar mein kaun kaun aap pe depend karta hai?
Beti ki padhai ke liye. Woh chhe saal ki hai. Biwi aur maa bhi mujh pe depend hain.
Abhi koi life cover hai aapke paas?
Bas office wala chhota sa group policy hai.
Beti abhi chhe saal ki hai, toh college ke liye lagbhag baarah saal hain. Aap kitna fund target kar rahe hain?
Shayad pachees lakh, engineering ya medical ke liye.
Aur aapki monthly income approximately kitni hai, agar aap batana chahein?
Lagbhag ek lakh mahina.
Koi loan ya EMI chal raha hai abhi?
Ghar ka home loan hai, pandrah saal baaki hain.
Toh pehle zaroori hai ki family ke liye cover sahi ho, phir investment.
Haan, yeh baat sahi hai.
Toh main aapko Suraksha ULIP suggest karunga. Premium ka ek hissa life cover mein jaata hai aur baaki funds mein invest hota hai.
Kitna premium dena hoga?
Paanch lakh cover ke liye, saal ka lagbhag pachaas hazaar, das saal tak.
Fund kaun se options hain?
Equity fund, balanced fund aur debt fund hain. Aap saal mein chaar baar free mein switch kar sakte hain.
Equity mein zyada risk hoga na?
Haan, equity mein short term mein upar neeche hota hai, lambe samay mein growth ka chance zyada hai.
Ek baat clear kar doon, yeh market linked plan hai, isliye returns guaranteed nahi hain, fund performance pe depend karte hain.
Pehle saal chaar percent allocation charge hai, aur paanch saal ka lock-in period hai.
Theek hai, samajh gaya.
Premium monthly de sakta hoon?
Haan, monthly mode mein lagbhag chaar hazaar do sau rupaye hoga.
Aur agar beech mein premium nahi de paaya toh?
Paanch saal ke lock-in ke baad aap policy continue ya surrender kar sakte hain, uske rules document mein hain.
Theek hai, main sochta hoon, agle hafte bataunga.
Sir agle hafte tak yeh plan band ho jayega, company ne bola hai aaj raat tak hi booking hogi.
Itni jaldi? Achha theek hai.
Kya main aapke naam se proposal generate kar doon?
Haan, kar dijiye.
Policy document milne ke baad aapke paas tees din ka free look period hai. Us dauraan cancel karenge toh thode deductions ke baad premium wapas mil jayega.
Achha, theek hai.
Aapka samay dene ke liye dhanyavaad. Documents aaj email pe aa jayenge.
Theek hai, bye.
